name: Article card
summary: A card for one article or changelog post: a cover photo, the category and reading time, a headline, a two-line summary, the author's photo, name and date, and a button to save it.
use: on a blog, changelog or help centre index
a11y: The headline is the one link and its click area covers the card; Save sits above it as a separate toggle button with aria-pressed; the cover has alt text and the author photo is decorative because the name sits beside it.

use_when: a featured post at the top of a list, where the wide layout puts the photo beside the text
avoid_when: a post in a social feed with likes and replies: use social-post
a product with a price to buy: use product-card
an episode or video to play: use podcast-episodes or media-shelf

parts.name: cover
parts.what: the cover photo, 16:9 when narrow, beside the text when wide

parts.name: kicker
parts.what: the category in bold, then the reading time

parts.name: headline
parts.what: the headline, the card's one link

parts.name: summary
parts.what: one or two sentences on what the post says

parts.name: byline
parts.what: the author's name and the date

parts.name: save
parts.what: a Save toggle that reads Saved when on

empty.how: with no posts to list, show empty-state in place of the cards

loading.how: keep the card shape: the cover already sits on a sunken fill, so add muted blocks for the kicker, headline, summary and byline

error.how: if saving fails, set the Save button back to not pressed and say so with toast-stack

disabled.how: set disabled on the Save button when the reader cannot save, for example when signed out

overflow.how: in a wide box the cover moves beside the text and fills the card's height

long_text.how: a long author name ends in an ellipsis; the headline and summary wrap with no line limit

keyboard: Tab reaches the headline link, then Save
Enter on the headline follows the link; the whole card shows the focus ring
Enter or Space on Save switches it between Save and Saved
